On this page

In May, no donations were received, this means the current progress for the laptop goal is still $163,79. However, the support on mods has been incredible last month! And I'd like to thank all the support the community has been giving me all these three years since I started making mods. It's crazy to think everything started when I made my first project called Magic Mod which later turned out to be Crate Delight.

I still need to finish a really cool project I started last year, which has been sitting somewhere in my folders for a long time now. This one will be released before the year ends.

Last month I also made a Ko-Fi page to be even more transparent on how many donations are received. You can check it pressing the button below.

All donations are highly appreciated!
